title: b12207
description: ggml-cuda : add d_state=64 fast path to SSM_SCAN kernel ( #31818 ) Zamba2 and similar architectures use a state size of 64 in their recurrent-scan step, which fell outside the GPU kernel's existing fast paths (96, 128, 256). Every scan step was falling back to CPU, bottlenecking generation to 6-7 tok/s against the 50-70 tok/s band other architectures achieve on the same hardware.
